name: Yasue
source:
Once a renowned grand mage, the calm and cheerful Lady Yasue now finds herself sealed in an unchanging Sapporo; one eternally stuck in the Meiji era.

Only a century later would she find company beyond those she was sealed with, when the confused and afraid Honoka inadvertently visited her sealed world. Even locked away from reality, Lady Yasue continues to direct magical performances at her beloved kabuki venue, and is only too happy to dote on her new visitor.

[From Steam]
